querystring.select: SELECT T.APP_NO AS AppNo, O.OFFICE_NAME AS OfficeName, C.CUST_NAME AS CustName, T.CUST_DATA_TRX_ID AS AppId, T.PROD_OFFERING_NAME AS ProdOfferingName, T.PROD_OFFERING_CODE AS ProdOfferingCode, T.PROD_OFFERING_VERSION AS ProdOfferingVersion
querystring.from: FROM TASK_UPD_CUST_DATA AS T INNER JOIN CUST AS C ON T.CUST_NO = C.CUST_NO INNER JOIN REF_OFFICE AS O ON T.REF_OFFICE_ID = O.REF_OFFICE_ID
